scope: Authenticated GitHub metadata census with bounded selected semantic source review; no competitor execution/build/tests
window: Merged 2026-10-04 through 2026-10-21 inclusive, as returned at per-repo capture_end
limitations: PR census is metadata coverage, not semantic review of every PR.
Large compare endpoints are capped at 300 files and first 100 commit records; source-window.json records those limits.
Release listing checks up to 100 current release records; pins record latest stable and prerelease returned.
Default head, releases and PR census were captured separately; later merges can fall outside the frozen head.
Complete non-truncated current trees were inspected for source discovery; pinned source files are a focused selection.
No build, provider session, remote/mobile runtime, restart, or visual interaction was executed.
